bars.says: An expedition enters through a crystal mouth or a ruined shaft in a technological ruin, returns safely, and finds the same altered cavern and its surviving occupants after leaving and reloading.

meant.intent: Persistence includes actual changes and occupants, not just an unchanged seed or map label. Sealing is an explicit warned choice, never automatic cleanup. Delegated reject test: an erased home contradicts the root even if the next cave looks identical.
meant.source: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_lantern_deeps.md sections 5, 6 and 8; standing no-unreadable-vanishing ruling; delegated: persistent root in CASE.

accept: After an expedition mines a passage, leaves supplies and escorts a wounded animal down, a later return through its mouth finds the opened passage, supplies and that surviving animal; a save made below preserves the same place.
The shaft is part of a visible failed technological expedition site; cancelling a closure warning leaves those below and the way back intact.
reject: The mouth returns a fresh cave bearing the same name while the earlier excavation, supplies and animal are gone.
A bare shaft is scattered in empty desert, or a return/cleanup silently deletes the occupied cave.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires the causal player-visible distinction in the pictures; decorative, forced or unrelated substitutes fail an explicit clause.

range.varies: Each of the 2 mouth types, separately and both on a source; 0, 1, 8 and 40 colonists; animals/corpses/carried injured pawns/items; new entry, evacuation, return, death below, save below/above, reload while empty/occupied, closure cancel/confirm. Host fixed annual temperatures -80 to -40 C and boundary -40.01/-40/-39.99 C; default listed/unlisted host biomes. Sweep legal portal placements and disconnected interior candidates through Situation generator.
range.left_out: No planetary generation/painting, gravship transfer or multi-level dungeon chain. Deliberate confirmed permanent sealing may lose contents only with explicit contents warning; it is not a revisit case.

sees.control: A regenerated cave can look identical. Require persistent map and thing IDs plus changed terrain and injuries, and travel using normal jobs rather than only selecting the other map. Cancelled and confirmed closure use separate save forks.

meant.intent: The land is recognisably a luminous enclosed place rather than a generic dark cave with labelled objects. Delegated reject test: a surface map tinted blue or an unreadable pile of luminous assets misses his wondrous cavern. Enjoyment/wonder remains a prediction, not a pass metric.

accept: At ordinary colony view a visitor can follow a dark passage into blue mineral and fungal patches, pick out rock faces to mine, and see equipped remains and living shapes without a surface sun lighting the room.
A crowded worked gallery still separates the walking skeleton suit, rooted mind and inert metal from the stone being mined.
reject: A generic cave is uniformly blue and its crystals, bodies and walls overlap so that selecting names is the only way to tell what is alive or traversable.
The cave fills with a bright outdoor sky, surface rain or wind while its underground label remains correct.

range.left_out: No requirement for particular art variants, exact palette RGB, beauty score or photorealism; no claim to view flight without owner present.

bars.says: A lit expedition draws an existing reachable cave hunter during sustained ordinary-light work, while dim work or standing living Lantern light avoids that draw, and harvesting the Lantern removes its safe-light shelter.

meant.intent: Ordinary usable work-light must have a legible risk, and standing Lantern light must be genuinely different. Danger is native attention, not arbitrary hidden punishment. Safe means exemption from light-triggered draw only, not immunity to ordinary hunting or roof collapse. Delegated reject test: no usable risk contrast violates the frozen no-free-light constraint. The draw recruits a resident, never creates a pawn; no eligible resident or no legal route yields a readable quiet state.
meant.source: the_lantern_deeps.md sections 4, 5 and hard ban 6; LANTERNDEEPS_LANTERN_LIGHT_BUILD_1; MapComponent_LanternDeepDarkness.cs quotes the ruled 2026-09-02 light-beacon intent.

figurative.stands_for: exemption from this light-triggered draw while only standing Lantern light reaches the worker
figurative.accept: An ordinary hungry predator can still bite a worker standing in Lantern light; that does not revoke the safe-light distinction.

figurative.stands_for: attracts a native danger through its light-attention response, not a literal pulling force
figurative.accept: The predator walks along an open route toward the lit party; no force drags it.

accept: On comparable inhabited cave routes, a sustained lamp-lit work party visibly attracts an approaching native predator; a dim or Lantern-only work party avoids the light-triggered approach.
A lamp blocked by solid rock does not spoil Lantern-only shelter; an ordinary lamp that actually lights the sheltered worker does, and harvesting its Lantern removes that shelter.

After the reachable hunters have been killed or shut out, sustained lamp work shows that no hunter can answer; no animal appears. A later ordinary resident can answer only after it actually lives on the map and has a legal route.
reject: Only extraordinary proof lamps can trigger danger while ordinary standing lamps are always free, or Lantern-only workers receive the same light-triggered attacks as lamp workers.
A lamp behind solid rock cancels safe light, or adding a Lantern excuses ordinary light that reaches the worker.
An unexplained predator appears inside a sealed occupied room, with no readable approach or light-related sign.
The light response creates a fresh predator off-screen or outside the room and calls its walk toward the party a resident approach.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires the causal player-visible distinction in the pictures; decorative, forced or unrelated substitutes fail an explicit clause.

range.varies: Engine-reachable glow values 0 to roof cap and overlight; equal-brightness controls; Lantern/ordinary terrain/item/formation/mobile lights singly and mixed; rock occlusion, open doors, corners, overlapping source radii; 0/1/8/40 free colonists, downed/carried/dead removal and empty-map decay; sampling/threshold/cooldown boundaries, timer interruption/reload, harvest/replant, enough native prey/predators or explicit depletion. Geometry sweep includes source toggles without disabling kept systems. Eligible resident RM_BloodropMoth: alive/wild/mobile/not already drawn, absent/dead/downed/tame/already drawn, and legal route open/closed/reopened; ordinary births/spawns remain independently attributed. Exhausted and blocked cases require a quiet-state sign and no attention-created pawn.
range.left_out: Safe light does not prevent unprovoked ordinary hunting, injury or collapse. Empty eradicated caves and caves with no eligible reachable hunter show a quiet response and create no hunter; a danger contrast requires an eligible reachable resident. No light-metabolism simulation, Sipper drain or Hush invisibility.

sees.instrument: Light geometry calibrated against glow/contribution state plus natural exposure/timer and predator-path state trace. Track exposure changes and approaches under matched light histories; never call DrawSomethingToTheLight directly as proof. Record eligible resident IDs before exposure, chosen pawn ID, legal path, quiet-state sign and birth/spawn cause ledger.

bars.says: An explorer sees stationary crystals control dead machines that turn toward expedition light and defend a marked living gallery whose native crystal is more desirable to take than ordinary rock outside it, with a warning before extraction or attack provokes defence and a reachable retreat.

meant.intent: Recognition is demonstrated by causal embodied action, not claimed sentience. Designation warns; actual extraction/damage provokes bounded defence. Delegated reject test: the owner explicitly linked the changed relationship to remote bodies defending the crystals; still props and a moth raid do not meet that promise. The protected native crystal must tempt extraction before its inhabitants answer: useful stone somewhere else cannot substitute for this riches-to-inhabitants turn. Desirability is a practical construction/trade opportunity compared with reachable unprotected rock, not a prescribed price or guaranteed fortune.
meant.source: Owner event OWNER:1794375005355305543, 2026-11-11; owner experience 2026-10-20; the_lantern_deeps.md Shard-minds and Working Dead; delegated: precise territorial trigger and finite defence/retreat scope.

figurative.stands_for: the marked native lanternstone mineral cells protected by a living aware crystal, as defined by the controller overlay in R4
figurative.accept: A bare-walled gallery with no fungi is still a living gallery because an aware crystal protects its marked mineral cells.

figurative.stands_for: supplied unpowered chassis with no mind or power of their own, moved only by their linked crystal; not arbitrary wreckage or living colony mechs
figurative.accept: An empty chassis stands, turns and fights while its crystal controls it; its motion does not make it an independent living machine.

accept: Dead metal stands and turns when the party brings light to an aware crystal; selecting the body identifies its crystal controller. A protected mining designation warns before work; carrying it out sends those existing bodies against the intrusion.

The expedition stops work and withdraws along the shown passage; defenders return to their gallery. Destroying the controlling mind visibly ends its control, and surviving bodies remain accounted for.

The marked gallery holds the cave’s most desirable native crystal, which the party would rather take for useful luminous construction or trade than ordinary stone; the reachable unprotected rock offers no equivalent haul for comparable work.
reject: A mind’s label says sentient and a stationary chassis emits dust, but mining changes nothing except a lore message.
Mining summons an unrelated raid or endless fresh droids, or peaceful Orun-Ghal becomes a boss, or a defender chases the expedition through the return portal.
The warning is printed after the first injury, a designation alone instantly starts combat, or all retreat paths are sealed by the very response being demonstrated.
The protected cells offer the same ordinary stone or an equivalent lanternstone haul already available unprotected nearby, so the party has no practical reason to risk extraction there.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires the causal player-visible distinction in the pictures; decorative, forced or unrelated substitutes fail an explicit clause.

range.varies: Controller/body counts 0/1/multiple; intact/blocked/destroyed/downed bodies; overlapping mind reaches; ordinary light, Lantern-only light and dark changes; protected concentrated RM_LanternstoneWall deposits vs reachable unprotected ordinary rock and any scattered lanternstone; fresh and partly worked deposits; construction-led and trade-led expedition needs; limited vs ample native-resource stocks, attack to mind/chassis, designation cancel and completed extraction; friendly/hostile/no relationship, injury, target death, retreat, simultaneous miners up to 40, save/reload during warn/defend/return. Include depleted-body and blocked-path cases; no bodies means visibly unable to defend, not an invented army.
range.left_out: No recruitable body, resurrection of human corpse, sentience in every stone, colony-droid theft, mindstone manufacture, global reputation war or path-cutting boss. Ordinary Lantern harvest outside protected mineral is safe from territorial defence.

sees.instrument: Encounter walk state trace plus live view of warning, body response and controller sign; compare actual mining/attack jobs and no-intrusion forks. Reads new defence instrument specified in tickets. Compare ordinary mining, hauling and cutting jobs on matched save forks, identify resulting RM_Lanternstone and its actual loaded building/trade uses, and read the game’s work, route and sale information for protected and unprotected alternatives. Whole cave season supplies the calibrated native-resource opportunity comparison.
sees.start: A generated reachable mind gallery with associated finite chassis, intact return route, unprovoked state, same roster/light history across forks. No manual attack order assigned to defenders; future instrument must read real production controller links. Use actual generated native lanternstone deposits and loaded construction/trade uses, not debug-added campaign crystals or valuables. Journal reachable unprotected alternatives, work/path costs and the party’s declared material use before extraction.

Record the same body/controller IDs before/after, tag the triggering completed job/damage and show cancellation/unprotected-rock forks stay unprovoked. Visibly disable controller on another fork and compare. A rich salvage pile elsewhere cannot make worthless protected mineral pass. Compare only material obtained from the marked cells with reachable unprotected alternatives under the same workforce, cutter, trader/use and work opportunity; a label or higher nominal MarketValue without practical advantage fails.

Saved acquaintance belongs to the colony on this Deep; it is not an XP grind or a recruit. Delegated reject test: a number called friend without changed encounters misses the explicit answer.

bars.says: Across a season of exploration, work, study and return, the complete inhabited cave keeps its light choices, living pasture, readable crystal responses and usable routes through a reload and a changed action order, without unbounded arrivals, unintended loss of native life, stalled warnings or repeated errors.

meant.intent: Exactly the whole bar: shipped first version, every kept mechanic active concurrently. The place can be worked and revisited without becoming an attention factory or generic empty tunnel. Delegated reject test: each staged feature succeeding while their combined season floods, starves, stalls or errors would betray the persistent inhabited cave.
meant.source: CASE whole-bar requirement and owner 2026-11-16 whole-system cleansing instruction; delegated: concrete flood/desert/stall pictures from current exposure/regrowth/controller/roof coupling.

accept: During a season the party gathers, lights work areas, studies, provokes a gallery and withdraws, props a roof, leaves and returns; after a mid-season save and reload the cave remains recognisably the worked inhabited place with safe-light and ordinary-light choices still useful.

Doing study and safe harvesting before protected mining, then doing protected mining and retreat before study, preserves the causal warning, danger and peaceful inhabitant behaviour rather than silently skipping a branch.
reject: With the complete cave enabled, repeated light draws fill passages with new attackers, grazing and mining strip the remaining living encounters, or duplicate controlled bodies block the return route.
After reload the warning queue never resolves, the friend forgets the colony, a disabled extra resumes jobs, or a recurring exception makes the cave unusable.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires the causal player-visible distinction in the pictures; decorative, forced or unrelated substitutes fail an explicit clause.

range.varies: Full generated 66x66 cave, 15 in-game days per season run, 1/8/40 colonists and native roster, work occupying 0/25/75 percent of initially accessible floor, both mouth types; empty intervals and visits. Mid-save at day 7 or pending warning/defence/study boundary. Branch A study->ordinary harvest->protected mining->retreat->prop->return; branch B protected mining->retreat->prop->study->ordinary harvest->return. Add day-100 continuation to catch saved accumulators. Compressed wall-clock is allowed only by tick acceleration preserving production ticks, jobs/pathing, weather, nutrition, light sampling, cooldowns and RNG ordering, never direct hourly helper loops.
range.left_out: Deliberately exterminating all fauna or paving all pasture is allowed to remove it; report player-caused depletion separately. No guarantee a crowded cave feeds the colony, and no next-version feature is a required active input.

sees.instrument: Whole cave season calibrated trace and real full-map state sampling with causal event counters, saved identity checks and attributed logs; reference live readability judgements from B2/B5/B6 across their ranges.
sees.start: Fresh ordinary generated source/Deep with shipped settings exported, all kept life and encounters unlocked, no fixed-clear weather and no forced proof counters. Journal actual initial geometry, populations, products and risk state; import no fixture food into native budget.
sees.on: All kept land, life, light attention, safe Lantern, crystal control/defence, real friendship and roof warnings enabled together at proposed shipped defaults; all DLC present, next-version extras off, ordinary weather/time free to run, no unlock or proof-forcing flag active.
sees.control: Feature-specific staging or settings drift can fake a season. Capture loaded definitions/settings/assembly fingerprints before and after, assert all kept toggles and freely advancing weather/time each sample, compare matched action-order forks and uninterrupted versus reload trace at the same tick/RNG state. New bars never demand a fixed ecological percentage.
sees.reset: Use a positively owned disposable source/cave save pair and fixture journal. Return through the portal with keep semantics; restore settings, jobs and current-map selection from journal. Destroy only positively owned empty test maps after evidence export; never call destructive LeaveDeep on a reused Deep. An aborted run resumes cleanup from journal.
sees.live_only_why: State transitions, identities and comparative outcomes are available to the specified calibrated model and game state read; no visual-only judgement is asserted by this bar.

eligibility.reject_test: Exactly the whole bar: shipped first version, every kept mechanic active concurrently. The place can be worked and revisited without becoming an attention factory or generic empty tunnel. Delegated reject test: each staged feature succeeding while their combined season floods, starves, stalls or errors would betray the persistent inhabited cave.
eligibility.renormalize_test: The player-visible comparison survives numeric retuning and added art; exact constants, product counts and variant counts occur only in checks/range/rules.

checks.what: XML: RM_LanternDeeps generatesNaturally=false, canAutoChoose=false, animalDensity positive; generator isUnderground/forceCaves and UndergroundCave mutator resolve. Current 66-cell size and 17 C are tunings, not bars.

Current default host strings include BiomeGRimond, RM_SleepingIce, RM_TheChill; compare to supported loaded current host names and fixed climate, flag stale string separately from observed eligibility.
Exposure constants and saved lightExposure/lastAmbushTick match their declared values; test before/at/after threshold and cooldown without assigning any numeric pass experience.
Light-source provenance includes RM_Lantern, ordinary RM_Lanternstone_Sowable, item/floor, formation, fungal and mobile glowers; distinguish blocked from mixed light.

Loaded active local fauna roster, parsed as XML element names, matches approved snapshot. Dormant RM_FacetMothLarvae, RM_MossBeetleLarvae and RM_Megapleura are not silently added by stale validation requirements; RM_OsskBramble is likewise defined but not locally rostered.

Products resolve through their actual owning packages; current RM_ColdWax provider is unknown in this checkout. Thrakk/Vellok currently yield no wood. Distinguish older insect meat/blood from wave hydrocarbon animals. Read loaded RM_Lanternstone MarketValue (currently 1 in RM_LanternstoneItems.xml), stuff/construction uses, drop/cutting data and reachable protected/unprotected deposit work/path costs; these numbers regress tuning and cannot replace B5’s practical desirability comparison.
Existing collapse fuzz covers pending/forced/released/reload bookkeeping; calibrated support/fall integration and job actionability remain necessary. Current warning default 900 ticks is a check.
Study reservations, completions, sessions/standing/lastVisitDay/lastStudyTick saved; no duplicated daily credit. Current tier thresholds 2/5/9 and study ticks/XP are data, with optional XP off.

Every default-off ticket verifies actual loaded effect absence AND enabled natural trigger presence; gate unconditional Cleaver trail, Pooler fire branches, XML links and Sipper breeder, not just settings labels.
Wreckage generator/class and SleepingIce wreck child defs packaged in composite; all required DLC present and RM free roster independent of franchise patches.
Identity conservation for controlled chassis/defenders: available + active + damaged/dead + visibly salvaged totals match original supplied bodies; no duplicate conversion on reload.

No current gameplay proof claimed: historical A1/A2/collapse/Sipper fuzz evidence is stale and bounds prerequisite/bookkeeping checks. Required future scripts emit settings/build/save fingerprints and owned cleanup results.

rules.rule: Use persistent vanilla MapPortal/CaveExit on the fixed world. Default host eligibility is the intersection of loaded supported cold-host biomes and fixed source-tile annual temperature <= -40 C on the nightside; indoor temperature/cold snap never qualifies. Local cave/entrance map generation is allowed, automated planetary generation is prohibited. Multiple mouths create independent cave identities unless explicitly linked; never silently merge or replace an occupied Deep.

Keep gravel, soil, shallow water, blue rock/formations and still-cave hum. Cave air uses ordinary fixed pocket temperature (current 17 C); no sky/direct solar heating penetrates an intact roof. Direct Sun remains the single shared geometric rule on the surface. Shaft dressing is local technological ruins, not a new world site.

Classify light by actual engine contributions after occlusion, not distance to nominal glower. Only standing RM_Lantern contribution exempts attention; ordinary formation, fungal, terrain, item and animal light does not. No colonial lamps means ambient native glow alone does not conjure attacks on absent colonists. For colonists use brightest exposed worker, not summed headcount; current 250-tick sample, roof-normalized squared glow, exposure threshold 60, decay 1.5 and cooldown 15000 ticks are attackable tuning checks. A light draw never creates a pawn: it recruits only an existing alive, wild, mobile RM_BloodropMoth not already drawn, on this map with a legal traversable route to the exposed worker. With none eligible or reachable, inspect shows the cave is quiet and why; nothing spawns. Ordinary births and existing population replenishment remain independent: attention never requests, accelerates or reserves them.

Each mind has a visible inspect/select overlay for its protected gallery: current starting reach 7 cells in horizontal Euclidean distance, clipped to this map and native RM_LanternstoneWall cells bordering reachable open floor; radio/crystal control may cross rock within that reach. Ordinary light facing uses actual received light and a visible target, not seeing through rock. Associate finite existing chassis by stable mind/body IDs; overlap belongs to nearest living mind, ties stable ID. No body duplication, corpse erasure or colony-droid conversion. Protected deposits are concentrated workable native lanternstone, mined to RM_ChunkLanternstone and cut into RM_Lanternstone; they must offer a more desirable construction/trade opportunity than reachable unprotected ordinary rock, without an equivalent easy unguarded lanternstone haul nearby. Scattered unprotected lanternstone may remain, with no new mineral type or campaign dependency.

Designating protected native lanternstone (the R4 deposit) or attacking the mind/chassis exposes a warning and controller relation. Only actual damage or completed protected extraction provokes existing chassis; no remote defence for unprotected ordinary stone or standing Lantern harvest. Defenders use ordinary melee jobs, remain within their controller reach, return when intruders retreat, and visibly slump when no living controller remains. A blocked path means visible guarding, never teleportation. Mine and withdraw can repeat without creating bodies. Orun never defends. Initial proposed wind-up is 250 production ticks with visible activation before retaliation; it is a tuning rule, never a bar number.

Orun acquaintance is saved per colony per Deep, earned only by completed reachable study visits, limited to one credited visit per in-game day (existing stricter cooldown may be retained as tuning). Greeting when a familiar colony returns: walk to a reachable visitor, stop facing them, give a brief distinctive blue greeting pulse, then resume harmless company/rounds. Never forcibly interrupt drafted/medical/emergency player work. Downed suit has no greeting/study; destroyed suit stays dead. Gallery hostility defers greeting until safe, but does not erase acquaintance.

Keep ordinary animal bodies, products and current admission status; no evictions, new dormant placements or global duplicate sweeps. Use ordinary food/grazing/predation/reproduction, real fictional flight and native-water compatibility. Maintain cave-native initial flora/animals and regrowth through existing engine APIs. Ordinary body glow is life. No special breeder, wound linking, battery, heat, hide/lunge, fuel trail, splitting or storm modifier is required at defaults.

Use vanilla roof support/fall geometry and existing DeepCollapseState for pending/due/released state. Dust, sand and rumble precede ordinary falling roofs; a timely completed support can cancel the fall. Disabled Knocker must contribute factor 1; disabled galuush ignition cannot mark forced cells. Save pending state, then re-evaluate actual support at deadline; never reset deadlines on repeat marks.

Master-off stops new entrances, never deletes existing maps/inhabitants. Every kept major feature has a labelled switch and scope (new-map versus live); all-off stops custom activity gracefully without erasure, keeps return routes and warns that vanilla roof behaviour resumes. Existing cross-biome host selection remains labelled unsupported outside shipped cold hosts; never add a new cross-biome switch. Next-version gates default off even if code shares a class with a kept component. An explicitly empty host selection remains empty after reload; no silent reset to defaults.

Native lanternstone remains useful for construction/trade, with the R4 protected deposits a better expedition opportunity than ordinary unprotected rock. Puffer remains edible and lace supplies cloth; no guaranteed fortune or mushroom logs. Fuel milk/butcher products must resolve at their existing provider. Keep Wreckage field policy and Bones remains lifecycle as dependencies; no second salvage ladder. Do not expose campaign mindstone/Kindled/kyber/Force plots at defaults or leak late Cathedral knowledge.

Evidence uses owned disposable fixtures and declared production fingerprints; normal ticks/jobs and both action orders, with model calibration before trust. Existing ProofStudy/forced split/held roof and A2 prerequisite strings are regression probes only. Never accept destructive default harness cleanup as a persistence result, or an unavailable read as a measured zero.

meetings.why: Vanilla persistent map identity, non-destructive return, journal ownership and per-Deep acquaintance use the same saved map. No kept operation calls cleanup as gameplay. Interrupted save/return still needs the generator regression; no competing lifetime owner remains.

Entrances, resource/creature placement, gallery combat reach, huge-drawn ordinary-footprint suit and timed roof escape can each fit in isolation while collectively blocking the only route. All kept layers must be composed on generated full caves.

No kept feature duplicates or silently erases occupants: finite body transitions conserve identity, Orun is excluded from defence and death persists, colony-machine listening is default-off; light attention recruits only an existing reachable resident and creates no pawn. Population sustainability remains explicitly unresolved in ecology, and action-order/controller races in controller state.

Feature gates own their contributions; new-map off never deletes old maps, and live off releases its custom jobs/modifiers. Default fixtures enable every kept contribution and disable all moved paths. Off-state checks can vary settings but never count as default passing evidence.

Blue terrain, ordinary native glowers, safe Lanterns, mobile sources, solid occlusion and roof glow cap share the engine grid. Existing radius-only classification cannot establish the kept risk distinction or readable facing.

The protected native lanternstone must be practically more desirable to extract than reachable unprotected rock while ordinary construction/forage/fuel remain usable. Existing low-value stone data, scattered unguarded lanternstone, deposit placement, work/haul costs and colony stocks could remove that temptation despite individually correct defence and resources. Campaign minerals or distant salvage cannot substitute; real-job comparison and a native-resource budget must settle it.
Existing kernel bookkeeping is not proof that actual vanilla support, body/path clutter, light-attention danger and warning job time permit escape or successful propping together.

Initial placement, roof-limited flora, ordinary grazing, resident-only light-triggered approaches with no attention-created pawns, taming and external supplies can form a depletion/arrival loop at colony scale; pairwise correct feeding and draw do not settle that season. Ordinary replenishment must remain independent of attention; intentional eradication is an explicit B8 exclusion, while unintentional season depletion is still a failure.

Exposure/cooldown, visible warning, gallery defence, retreat and peaceful greetings may overlap or starve each other when orders change or save intervenes. The causal chain must continue without turning its peaceful representative hostile. Resident depletion and route closure must produce the explicit quiet state, not spawn a replacement or starve peaceful encounters.
Finite body ownership, overlapping minds, controller death, real study completions and return greeting must survive reload without double bodies, global hostility or duplicate acquaintance credit.
